a: systemctl enable --now service starts and enables on boot.
journalctl -fu service follows logs for a unit.
ss -tulpn shows listening sockets and processes.
lsof lists open files and the processes using them.
strace traces system calls made by a process.
ulimit controls resource limits for a shell session.
@reboot runs a cron job at system startup.
rsync --delete makes the destination match source exactly.
